newsitem.title: UK: EMI shares fall after profits slide.
newsitem.headline: EMI shares fall after profits slide.

text.p: Shares in EMI Group Plc were indicated lower in pre-market trade on Tuesday after the group reported a six percent decline in pretax profits for the nine months to end December.
The shares fell 33p to 11.60 stg by 0815 GMT.

EMI said pre-exceptional pre-tax profits fell to 293.3 million stg from 312.4 million stg a year earlier. Operating profit excluding exceptional items fell to 305.9 million stg from 331.5 million stg.
Analysts had been expecting operating profits of between 326-377 million stg.
But the company said it remained confident that its results for the full year would be better than those in the previous year.
EMI said its release schedule was more heavily weighted towards the final quarter this year and so far sales in the fourth quarter were in line with expectations.
